mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profit expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines in a late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior quarter indicates weakening demand for new homes, which reduces construction activity and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-housing bubble regime, a decline in residential sales (RSAFS) signals reduced consumer demand for housing, which dampens overall economic activity and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines in a post-housing bubble regime, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
